items.title: Why Aerospace Companies Keep Choosing Montréal
items.summary: Sumit Singh of Simple Flying sits down with Montréal International to explore how the city became one of the world's leading aerospace hubs. From a 43,000-strong aerospace workforce and a fully integrated supply chain to major players like Airbus, Bombardier, and Pratt & Whitney, the interview examines what keeps companies investing in Montréal and how growing opportunities across commercial aviation, space, and defense could shape the region's next phase of growth.
